scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run prepare && vite build --config web/vite.config.ts
scripts.build:contract: bash scripts/with-toolchain.sh bash -c 'cd df-billboard && aztec compile'
scripts.build:portal: bash scripts/with-toolchain.sh bash -c 'cd df-billboard/portal && aztec-forge build'
scripts.build:contracts: npm run build:contract && npm run build:portal
scripts.format: npm run lint:fix && prettier --config web/.prettierrc --write "web/**/*.{ts,tsx,mjs,css,json,html}" "protocol/**/*.mjs" "runtime/**/*.mjs" "tests/**/*.mjs" eslint.config.mjs package.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --config web/.prettierrc --check "web/**/*.{ts,tsx,mjs,css,json,html}" "protocol/**/*.mjs" "runtime/**/*.mjs" "tests/**/*.mjs" eslint.config.mjs package.json && npm run lint
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:message && npm run test:release
scripts.test:contracts: bash scripts/with-toolchain.sh bash -c 'cd df-billboard && aztec test' && npm run test:portal
scripts.test:portal: bash scripts/with-toolchain.sh bash -c 'cd df-billboard/portal && aztec-forge test'
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:message && npm run test:deployment
